title: Pointwise reduction of the second-variation integrand for a normal velocity with ⟨X, H⟩ = 0 (Simon 5.11 core)
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (φ : ℝ → Rn N → Rn N) (y : Rn N), (∀ τ ∈ tangentSpace M y, ∀ η ∈ tangentSpace M y, secondFundamentalForm M y τ η = secondFundamentalForm M y η τ) → (∀ τ ∈ tangentSpace M y, ∀ η ∈ tangentSpace M y, inner ℝ η (fderiv ℝ (initialVelocity φ) y τ) = -inner ℝ (initialVelocity φ y) (secondFundamentalForm M y τ η)) → inner ℝ (initialVelocity φ y) (meanCurvature M y) = 0 → secondVariationIntegrand M φ y = tangentialDivergence M (initialAcceleration φ) y + stableSecondVariationIntegrand M φ y
